purpose: TIA Openness capability and format route matrix
truthPolicy: Routes describe supported authoring paths; live tool diagnostics refine the current project result.

write-source.guidance: Direct text-source generation through ExternalSource.CreateFromFile + GenerateBlocksFromSource.

import-xml.maturePattern: SimaticML/XML import using real exported templates
import-xml.guidance: Use the structured LAD/FBD generator directly; exported templates and evidence tools help diagnose uncovered shapes.

import-sd.maturePattern: SIMATIC SD text documents (.s7dcl + .s7res) via Blocks.ImportFromDocuments / PlcBlock.ExportAsDocument
import-sd.restriction: TIA Portal V20+ only. V20: LAD/DB/UDT (SCL from V20 Update 4); V21 adds FBD and mixed-language blocks; no STL. SIMATIC SD is a per-version dialect: the .s7dcl header must match the target portal (V20: S7_Language; V21: S7_PreferredLanguage+S7_Version) — a dialect mismatch fails with Siemens' MISLEADING 'no en-US entries' error, which is a red herring (real-machine confirmed); regenerate with schema_version matching the portal. Bridge commands import-block-sd/export-block-sd exist but local import/compile proof is still pending; V15-V19 must use import-xml or write-source.
